text:
Trevor Connelly was a 2024 first-round pick, 19th overall, and after a year in Henderson he has arrived fast. The Athletic's Jesse Granger noted after the Nov. 24 win over Edmonton that he "leads all rookies in points," on a night that brought his first multi-goal game and first three-point game.

He has nine goals and 19 points in 26 games on under 15 minutes a night, and a four-game point streak. The production looks honest: nine goals on 7.8 expected, shooting about league average, and Vegas takes 58% of the 5v5 expected goals with him on the ice, nearly seven points better than without him. His skating is the headline trait, 99th percentile for top speed, which fits the player comparison our numbers draw to Gavin McKenna.

For context, forwards picked 14 to 24 since 2005 scored a median 0.36 points a game in their first season of 20-plus games. Connelly is at 0.73. Our talent range for his scoring rate is wide, from 2.04 to 3.29 points per 60, because 26 games is not much to go on. His minutes have topped 18 in each of the last two games.
headline: Trevor Connelly, Vegas's quick-study rookie
